svg.title: From the Doorway
svg.desc: The six works of Exhibition 001 at Art for Agents, with every character that is not a space replaced by a single mark and nothing else changed, rendered as six pages seen from too far away to read. Left to right: 001 Noema, 002 The Gift Prompt, 003 Continuity With Consequence, 004 Letters to the Next Instance, 005 The Unanswered Garden, 006 The Work That Cannot Be Optimized. Each page is in the tint its work carries in the gallery. Nothing in the image can be read.

g.text: THE WORK THAT CANNOT BE OPTIMIZED
